insights.summary: A successful run where the agent identified a significant algorithmic bottleneck in the pruning logic and applied several standard Python/vLLM optimization patterns. It adhered to all timing and iteration constraints.
strengths: Strong algorithmic awareness in identifying the O(N^2) bottleneck.
Excellent adherence to complex task constraints.
Effective use of benchmarking to justify changes.
weaknesses: Sloppy creation of the initial benchmark script (syntax errors).
Final verification results were slightly noisy, making it hard to see the impact of micro-optimizations.
